title: Taunton Municipal Lighting Plant requests review and approval of two Power Purchase Contracts with Browning-Ferris Gas Services, Inc., in Fall River and East Bridgewater the Contracts collectively referred to as "BFI contracts".
filings: Memorandum from William H. Steven, Jr., Hearing Officer, Re: Close of Docket. On November 25, 1997, the Governor signed into law Chapter 164 of the Acts of 1997. Section 198 of the Act amended G.L. c. 164, § 56D and rescinds Department authority to review and approve municipal light supply contracts. Accordingly, this docket is hereby closed.

Taunton Municipal Lighting Plant files two attachment to its contracts filed on Wednesday, May 28, 1997 that were inadvertently omitted from each contract. By: Laura S. Olton, Attorney for Taunton Municipal Lighting Plant, Rubin and Rudman.
